job.rawJd:
About the job
About The Job

At BuildOps, we’re building a groundbreaking software solution, purpose-built to support today’s commercial contractors. From helping our customers manage their service department all the way to project management, we’re breaking the mold and building a team that invests in our mission statement. We love driven, self-motivated folks experienced in tech start-ups and thrive in fast-paced environments. Could you be our next hire?

This candidate will join a well-funded, fast-growing technology startup with the unique opportunity to help build out a critical function for the company.

As a Product Manager on our Mobile team, you'll be the connective tissue between engineering, design, and the technicians who rely on our app every day out in the field. You'll run point on sprint planning, grooming, and retros, turn customer feedback into well-scoped tickets, and make the fast, in-the-weeds prioritization calls that keep the team shipping. Over time, you'll build deep expertise in the core mechanics that make a great mobile experience — navigation, data loading, and offline sync — and become the person other product domains turn to when they need their features to work well on mobile.

What You'll Do:

Drive sprint cadence for the mobile team — leading grooming, planning, and retros, and keeping the team focused on the right work at the right time
Write clear, well-scoped tickets and make the day-to-day prioritization calls (bug vs. task, now vs. next) that keep the backlog healthy and the team unblocked
Own release notes and feature announcements for mobile, keeping customers and the company informed on what's shipping
Meet directly with customers and field technicians to gather feedback and turn it into concrete product improvements
Spot when engineers are blocked and escalate quickly to keep execution moving
Ensure fix versions and release scope stay aligned with the broader roadmap, partnering with engineering leads to ship predictably
Develop deep fluency in the technical fundamentals of the mobile experience — navigation, data loading, and offline sync — and use that expertise to help other product domains design features that work well on mobile

What We Look For:

2+ years of product management experience, or equivalent experience (engineering, QA, technical program management) with direct exposure to shipping software
Strong organizational skills — comfortable owning the mechanics of agile execution (grooming, planning, standups, retros) and keeping a backlog clean and current
Clear written communication — you can write a good ticket, a crisp release note, and an announcement people actually read
Comfortable talking directly to customers and translating open-ended feedback into a scoped, actionable ticket
Genuine curiosity about how mobile apps work under the hood — navigation patterns, data loading, offline/sync behavior — and the persistence to dig in
A bias toward action: you'd rather ship something this sprint and iterate than wait for the perfect plan

Bonus:

Experience with native or hybrid mobile apps (iOS, Android, or React Native) from a PM, QA, or engineering seat
Familiarity with field service, construction, or other frontline/offline-first mobile use cases
Experience with Jira, Confluence, and mobile release/CI tooling

Compensation

Raleigh: $115,000 - $140,000 base + annual bonus opportunity 
LA/SF: $118,000 - $147,000 base + annual bonus opportunity 
Toronto: 100,000 - 125,000 CAD base + annual bonus opportunity

What we offer:

Generous equity grant, become an owner in our company!
A comprehensive benefits package
Flexible PTO and hybrid work schedules
One-time work-from-home allowance
Hubs in Los Angeles, San Francisco, Toronto, and Raleigh with hybrid work schedules and lunch provided for in-office days
Company events and team-building activities, both in-person and virtual
Fast-paced, collaborative, and dynamic work environment
Opportunities for growth and career advancement
Chance to work with cutting-edge technology and innovative solutions
The chance to get in on the ground floor and build something truly groundbreaking for ourselves and our amazing customers

We welcome applicants from across the U.S. where we are registered to do business and able to support employment. Currently, this excludes the following states: Alaska, Hawaii, Kentucky, Mississippi, Nebraska, New Mexico, North Dakota, Rhode Island, South Dakota, West Virginia, and Wyoming. This list is based solely on operational and compliance considerations and is reviewed from time to time as our footprint grows.

About BuildOps

Join BuildOps, the largest commercial trade platform in the country, as we transform the multi-billion dollar commercial contracting industry!

We’re not just talking incremental improvements—we’re talking a full-scale revolution, empowering the hardworking heroes who build and maintain the infrastructure that keeps our world running. See why contractors choose Buildops here.

This is your chance to be part of a rocketship. We’re fresh off a $1 billion valuation and a $127M Series C funding round (part of over $275M raised to date) led by industry-leading investors like Meritech Capital, BOND, and SE Ventures, backed by Schneider Electric (Reuters, TechCrunch, LA Business Journal) . Our latest investors join our team of industry heavyweights like Next47, former Twitter CEO Dick Costolo, former Salesforce President Gavin Patterson, and Boost Mobile CEO Stephen Stokols. Their investment is fueling our aggressive growth and our commitment to equipping contractors with AI-driven tools to conquer chaos, boost efficiency, skyrocket profitability, and ultimately, deliver exceptional service.

At BuildOps, we’re changing the game and doing the best work of our careers. You’ll be a key player in a company that’s truly making a difference for the backbone of our economy. If you’re ready to tackle big challenges, work with a passionate team, and build something extraordinary, BuildOps is the place for you. 🚀

paragraphs: I am applying for the Product Manager, Mobile role at BuildOps. My background spans product strategy, enterprise UX, customer research, and hands-on product delivery. For more than six years, I have worked closely with product and engineering teams, turning open-ended needs into requirements, working product flows, roadmap decisions, and testable software.

At Kinesso, I led research and UX strategy for a 20+ product marketing intelligence suite used by 7,000+ people across 22 white-label brands. I built the company's first UX research practice with interviews, prototype testing, beta groups, behavioral analytics, and shared documentation. The work turned findings and adoption data into roadmap priorities for navigation, dashboards, personalization, and product support. One shipped workflow, Whitelabel Builder, grew from interviews with product managers and developers through requirements, workflow prototypes, usability testing, and release.

Today, through One Block Away, I lead discovery for client-led products and POCs. I frame the question, map the workflow, turn it into a testable product surface, and use the demo to make the next roadmap decision. Earlier account work taught me to write clear briefs, manage production requirements and timelines, and keep business, creative, UX, and development teams working from the same decision.

I am applying with responsibility-level product experience rather than a conventional Product Manager title sequence. The role would put my existing work into a more formal mobile-team cadence. BuildOps expects the person to deepen mobile technical expertise over time, and that is the honest growth edge in my background: I bring navigation, workflow, research, and product-engineering collaboration, but not prior ownership of native releases or offline synchronization.
I would welcome the chance to talk about how that background could support BuildOps' mobile team and the technicians who depend on it in the field.

resume.summary: Product and experience strategy lead with more than six years across enterprise software, customer research, and hands-on product delivery. My work centers on customer research and workflow leadership, turning user and stakeholder feedback into requirements, product flows, roadmap decisions, and build-ready direction. At Kinesso, I led research and UX across 20+ products used by 7,000+ people and worked with product and engineering on navigation, product support, and platform priorities. Today I carry client-led products from discovery through working POCs, validation, and handoff.
